description: Curated answers for the identifiers `release-migrations` could not resolve between two releases: a flow whose source rows split across several flows, a flow whose unit changed, a redirect the export tells consumers to refuse, or an impact category the later release does not publish. Each ruling names the pair of releases (from_version, to_version), the entity (flow-object, elementary-flow, impact-category or characterization-factor), the identifier, and the verb: `replace` with `replaced_by` (and `conversion_factor` where the unit moved) or `delete`. Say why in `comment`. A ruling naming an identifier the pair did not leave unresolved is refused as stale. Read by brightway_flows.releases.rulings.
